title: Entropy-gated rollback controller with adaptive SLO windows
creator: Maya Patel
description: Proposal: implement an automated rollback gating mechanism that adapts trigger sensitivity based on signal entropy and traffic churn. Goal is to reduce false-positive rollbacks during noisy low-traffic periods while maintaining fast reaction to genuine regressions in latency, error_rate, token_cost, or throughput. The controller will compute an entropy score over recent metric distributions per cohort, dynamically expand or shrink the statistical window, and apply cost-normalized composite delta thresholds before surfacing or executing a rollback.
design_notes: Compute per-cohort histograms for each SLO signal (latency, error_rate, token_cost, throughput) using fixed buckets and recent N-minute windows.
Measure Shannon entropy of the histogram for each signal and aggregate into an entropy index (weighted by signal importance and sample size).
Map entropy -> window_size: low entropy => shorter window (faster reaction), high entropy => longer window (smoother). Window sizes bounded between 1m and 60m.
Compute cost-normalized z-scores for scalar SLO deltas: z = (observed - baseline)/sigma, then scale by token_cost_per_unit for cost-sensitive signals.
Require multi-signal corroboration: rollback only if at least two signal categories exceed per-signal thresholds OR a single critical signal (e.g., error_rate) crosses a hard threshold.
Introduce hysteresis and cooldown: after a rollback decision, suppress automated rollbacks for X minutes to prevent thrashing; allow manual override.
Cohort-awareness: compute entropy and thresholds per region/customer-tier/model-variant to avoid cross-cohort dilution.
Expose tuning knobs in Console: base thresholds, entropy sensitivity curve, min_sample_size, cooldown window, and cost weights.
Simulation harness: replay historical canary traces to tune mapping and evaluate false positive rate (target < 1%) and time-to-detect for real regressions (target < 3m for P0-level errors).
Fallback behavior: when metric volume is below min_sample_size, fall back to conservative policy (manual escalation or alert-only).
acceptance_criteria: Unit and integration tests for entropy computation and window adaptation (coverage > 90%).
Simulation: on historical canaries, false-positive rollback rate < 1% and true positive detection within target latency for injected regressions.
Console UI: new knobs appear under rollout-safety with sensible defaults and tooltips; toggling persists to tenant config.
End-to-end canary: staged rollout with automatic gating enabled successfully aborts a synthetic error-rate regression in a dedicated test cluster.
Monitoring: dashboards for entropy index, per-signal z-scores, rollbacks executed, and suppressed events are available in Console by release date.
Operational runbook added to Playbooks with steps for manual override and post-rollback investigation.
Security review completed (if turned on for a tenant) and privacy check for per-customer cohorting affirmed.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (dev): library implementation + unit tests + simulation harness (owner: ENG infra team).
Phase 1 (internal canaries): enable for non-critical models in dev-only clusters, monitor false-positive rate and entropy distribution (2 weeks).
Phase 2 (beta tenants): opt-in release to 2 customers with varying traffic patterns; gather telemetry and adjust defaults (4 weeks).
Phase 3 (general availability): enable as opt-out for hosted Canary workflows and provide migration docs; offer dedicated tuning support for Dedicated/Private customers.
Abort criteria: increase in rollback-shaped incidents or user-facing errors attributable to gating change > 0.5% over baseline in any cohort.
monitoring_queries: Entropy calc (pseudo): sum(-p*log2(p)) over histogram buckets per cohort (exported as rollout_entropy_index)
Alert: rollout_autorollback_trigger{env="prod"} == 1 -> tag with reason (signal list) and entropy_index at trigger time
